levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: the leading «5-» is a report number; «رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ» is a formula: both left out
«جَمِيعاً عَنْ» : two co-transmitters meet at يعقوب بن يزيد, one level
«عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8)
the Imam is written after «عن» inside the chain, so he is narrator (owner ruling 2); his words «كَانَ آخِرَ أَوْصِيَاءِ عِيسَى» make him the last link (rule 6)
